day_local: Jimcaha Toddobaadka Todoba iyo Labaatanaad ee Waqtiga Caadiga ah
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha iyo Wiilka iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix ha idinla jirto.
penitential: Rabbiyow, naxariiso. Masiixow, naxariiso. Rabbiyow, naxariiso.
psalm_response: Rabbigu wuxuu weligiis xusuusan doonaa axdigiisa.
homily:
Waxaa jira saacado maalinta ka mid ah, gaar ahaan marka qorraxdu ay bilaabato inay hoos u dhacdo, oo gurigu uu noqdo mid aamusan, halkaas oo xusuusta ay si tartiib ah u soo gasho qolka. Waxaad arkeysaa wax yar oo maalinle ah: laga yaabee inay tahay xadhigga kabaha oo si qaldan u yaalla, ama buug uu Ben dhigay miiska, ama xataa sawirka diyaarad uu sida aadka ah u jeclaa oo weli derbiga sudhan. Waxyaalahan yaryar, oo aan muhiim u muuqan, ayaa ah meesha aan maanta ka bilaabayno. Waxay yihiin xusuus muujinaysa in nolosha Benjamin Vo ay ahayd mid dhab ah, mid qurux badan, oo weli halkan nala joogta.

Waxaan dooraneynaa hal sawir oo maanta nala socda: waa 'faraha Ilaah'. Injiilka maanta, Ciise wuxuu leeyahay: 'Haddii ay tahay faraha Ilaah inaan ku saaro jinniyada, markaas Boqortooyada Ilaah ayaa idinku soo degtay.' Faraha Ilaah. Ma aha gacan xoog leh oo wax burburinaysa, laakiin waa farahaas jilicsan ee taabta nolosha, ee xakameeya wax kasta oo mugdi ah. Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil yaqaanay sida loo isticmaalo farahiisa. Xusuusnow sida uu u dhisayey barnaamijyadiisa kombuyuutarka, sida uu ugu qorayey koodhka GitHub, ama sida uu ugu taabtay nolosha dadka kale jacayl aan xad lahayn. Ben wuxuu lahaa faro u taagnaa abuuridda, dhisidda, iyo jacaylka.

Laakiin intaanan halkaas sii marin, waa inaan si daacad ah u wajahno xanuunka. Alan iyo Thao, waan ogahay in saddexdan bilood ay ahaayeen kuwo adag. Waxaa jira waqtiyo aad dareemaysaan in faraha Ilaah ay fog yihiin, in mugdigu uu ka weyn yahay iftiinka. Waxaad is-weydiinaysaan: 'Maxaan seegnay? Ma jirtay wax aynu si kale u samayn karin?' Waxaan rabaa inaan halkan ku hakinno. Waxaan rabaa inaan idiin sheego runta: Ma jiro wax aad seegnay. Ma jiro qof eed leh. Cudurku ma aha ciqaab, mana aha guuldarro waalid. Sida Ciise uga jawaabay su'aashii ku saabsanayd ninkii indhoolaha ahaa: 'Ma aha ninkan iyo waalidkiis toona.' Ilaah ma eedeeyo, mana aha in aad adinkuna is-eedaysaan. Xanuunka halkan yaalla waa mid dhab ah, laakiin culayskaas ma ahan mid aad adinku keenteen. Waxaad siiseen Ben jacayl aan xad lahayn, waalidnimadiinuna waxay ahayd hadiyad uu Ben ku koray. Ha is-eedeynin; Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu ku jiraa gacmaha Aabbaha oo aanay jirin wax dhib ah.

Oo halkaas ayay nuurku ka soo galayaa qolka mugdiga ah. Bawlos, akhriska koowaad, wuxuu inoo sheegayaa: 'Kuwa iimaanka leh ayaa barakaysan.' Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil leh iimaan. Markii uu booqanayay Lourdes iyo Vatican-ka, wuxuu bartay inuu gacantiisa u dhiibo Ilaah. Wuxuu ahaa wiil aaminsan in 'isku daygu uu yahay waxa kaliya ee muhiimka ah'. Hadda, Ben wuxuu ku jiraa meel ka sarreysa daruuraha, meel aanay jirin xanuun ama daal. Wuxuu ku jiraa 'Banquet of Heaven'. Ma jiro baahi loo qabo inuu dhisayo 'con chim airlines', waayo wuxuu ku jiraa meel uu ka arki karo adduunka oo dhan, isagoo dhoola caddaynaya.

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, waan ogahay in mararka qaarkood aad dareemeyso in kursigaaga agtiisa uu yahay mid cidlo ah. Laakiin xusuuso in Ben uu ku jiro xusuustaada, riyooyinkaaga, iyo jacaylka aad wadaagteen. Ha ka cabsin inaad horay u socoto. Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu mar walba jeclaa. Wuxuu rabaa inaad ku raaxaysato nolosha, waayo adiga iyo isaga waxaa idin mideeyay jacayl aan dhimanayn. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay: 'Ha ka baqina, waayo waxaan idin sugayaa meel aan dhimasho lahayn.'

Markaad maanta ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaada hal shay oo yar oo aad gacanta ku haysaan: Ha is-edeynin, hana ka cabsanin inaad u dhiibto xanuunkaaga Ilaah. Ben wuxuu hadda ku sugan yahay nabadda gacmaha Aabbaha. Marka aad dareento cidlo, xusuuso in faraha Ilaah ay weli idin taabanayaan, iyagoo idin xusuusinaya in jacaylku uu weligiis noolaan doono. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay inaan la idin iloobin. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciise, waxaan aaminsanahay inaad ku sugan tahay Sacrament-ka Quduuska ah. Waxaan kaa codsanayaa inaad qalbigayga soo gasho, maadaama aanan hadda kuu qaadan karin si muuqata. Igu dhex noolow, oo ha ii oggolaan inaan weligay kaa go'o. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo, ha idin xafido, oo ha idin siiyo nabaddiisa. Aamiin.
standing_petitions: Wiilkeenna qaaliga ah ee Ben iyo dhammaan kuwii naga horreeyay ee dhintay, inuu Rabbigu ku dejiyo iftiinka wejigiisa weligiis.
Dhammaan qoysaska murugaysan iyo kuwa culeyska wada, inuu Ilaah siiyo raaxada Ruuxa Quduuska ah iyo rajo aan dhammaanayn.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Walaalayaal, ogaada in kuwa iimaanka leh ay yihiin carruurta Ibraahim. Qorniinku, oo horay u arkay in Ilaah uu dadka aan Yuhuudda ahayn ku xaqayn doono iimaanka, ayaa u sii sheegay injiilka Ibraahim, isagoo leh, 'Adiga ayaan dhammaan quruumaha ku barakayn doonaa.' Sidaas darteed, kuwa iimaanka leh ayaa la barakeeyaa iyada oo la raacayo Ibraahim oo iimaanka lahaa. Waayo, dhammaan kuwa shaqada sharciga ku tiirsan waxay ku jiraan habaar; waayo, waxaa qoran, 'Habaaran yahay qof kasta oo aan ku adkaysan inuu sameeyo waxyaalaha ku qoran kitaabka sharciga.' Inaan qofna Ilaah hortiisa sharciga ku xaqayn karin waa caddahay, waayo, kii iimaanka ku xaq ah wuu noolaan doonaa. Laakiin sharcigu iimaanka kuma tiirsana; halkii, kii waxyaalahaas sameeya wuu ku noolaan doonaa. Masiixu wuxuu inaga madax-furay habaarka sharciga isagoo inoo noqday habaar, waayo, waxaa qoran, 'Habaaran yahay qof kasta oo geed ku laadlaada,' si barakada Ibraahim loogu fidiyo dadka aan Yuhuudda ahayn iyada oo loo marayo Ciise Masiix, si aynu u helno ballanka Ruuxa iyada oo loo marayo iimaanka.

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: Rabbigu wuxuu weligiis xusuusan doonaa axdigiisa. Waxaan Rabbiga ugu mahadnaqi doonaa qalbigayga oo dhan, shirka iyo kulanka kuwa xaqa ah. Wayn yihiin shuqullada Rabbiga, oo aad u qurux badan dhammaan wixii uu ku farxo. Rabbigu wuxuu weligiis xusuusan doonaa axdigiisa. Sharaf iyo ammaan ayaa ah shuqulkiisa, oo xaqnimadiisu weligeedba way sii jiri doontaa. Wuxuu caan ku noqday shuqulladiisa cajaa'ibka leh; Rabbigu waa naxariis iyo raxmad. Rabbigu wuxuu weligiis xusuusan doonaa axdigiisa. Wuxuu cunto siiyay kuwa isaga ka cabsada; weligiis wuxuu xusuusan doonaa axdigiisa. Dadkiisa wuxuu u muujiyay awoodda shuqulladiisa, isagoo siiyay dhaxalka quruumaha. Rabbigu wuxuu weligiis xusuusan doonaa axdigiisa.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Markii Ciise uu jinni saaray, qaar ka mid ah dadkii badnaa ayaa yiri, 'Wuxuu jinniyada ku saaraa awoodda Beelsebul, oo ah amiirka jinniyada.' Kuwa kale, si ay u tijaabiyaan, waxay weydiisteen calaamad xagga jannada ka timaada. Laakiin wuu ogaa fikirkooda, wuxuuna ku yiri, 'Boqortooyo kasta oo is-khilaafta waa la baabbi'in doonaa, guri walbana wuu ku dumi doonaa guri kale. Haddii Shaydaanku is-khilaafo, sidee bay boqortooyadiisu u taagnaan kartaa? Waayo, waxaad leedihiin Beelsebul ayaan jinniyada ku saaraa. Haddii aan jinniyada ku saaro Beelsebul, yaa dadkiinna ku saara? Sidaas darteed iyaga ayaa idin xukumi doona. Laakiin haddii aan faraha Ilaah jinniyada ku saaro, markaas Boqortooyada Ilaah ayaa idinku soo degtay. Marka nin xoog badan oo hubaysan uu gurigiisa ilaaliyo, hantidiisu waa badbaado. Laakiin marka mid isaga ka xoog badan uu soo weeraro oo uu ka adkaado, wuxuu ka qaadaa hubkii uu ku tiirsanaa, wuxuuna qaybiyaa wixii uu qabsaday. Kii aan ila jiraa waa iga soo horjeedaa, kii aan ila ururinana wuu kala firdhiyaa. Marka ruux aan nadiif ahayn uu qof ka baxo, wuxuu dhex socdaa meelo cidla ah isagoo raadinaya nasasho, laakiin markuu waayi waayo, wuxuu yiraahdaa, 'Waxaan ku noqonayaa gurigaygii aan ka imid.' Laakiin markuu ku laabto, wuxuu helaa isagoo la nadiifiyay oo la habeeyay. Markaasuu tagaa oo soo kaxeeyaa toddoba ruux oo kale oo isaga ka sharka badan, wayna galaan oo deggaan, xaaladda ugu dambaysa ee ninkaasna waxay noqotaa mid ka daran tii hore.'

day: Friday of the Twenty-seventh Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben
